translation.name: Selections from Luke, Mark, Acts, Genesis, Ruth, and Romans

content: Nguthundiya ka-wingka Jijaj nankawala arnindawa, nankawa baji na-wini Kalili; kawulila-kala kanymardawujara mirningiyawujara, Jamun baki nyiki-anyira Anduru, kawul ila-kala dawarrkantharra arlku, rri-mangaji rrikirri-nganji ki-arlkuwu kawula-ninya.
Ka-wukanyi Jijaj wulanga, “Wambu wandi arlku! Kawa! Nganhimbala-wandarra ngarna! Kimbala-rdumanthaninya arlku ambuliyalu; bawuji barra kimbil irna-yangamala rdumanthawu li-wulu ngatha.”
Kulu kawula-nda wanika yinarrambalulu; kawula-wanda Jijaj.
Ka-wingka mili nguthundiya, kawulila-kala barra kanymarda mirningiyawujara, rrikirri-ardu ki-Jibidi, Jamij wula nyiki-anyira Jana, kawul ila-kala muwardala yabimantharra wanika.
Ka-wajba Jijaj wulanga wula wandayawu yiku; kawula-nda wambu nyawulanga-biyi, bajiwa wu-muwardala marda nalarrku yilaa wumba kala-ninya waki yiku, kalawula-nda baji, kawula-wanda barra Jijaj, bawuji.
